svg.title: OPH particle atlas V3: from a twist to a particle
svg.desc: A dark-mode illustrated explainer in nine numbered steps. It follows a topological defect through finite source examples and proposed physical interpretations. Each step distinguishes computed records from the proof required to identify physical position, momentum and mass. A receipt-bound panel links the candidate map, isolated gauge transition, static loop fusion and executed contact control; no source-derived GeV masses or identified physical species are asserted.
svg.text: From a twist to a particle
The proposed path from a protected source defect to an observer’s particle record
The OPH simulation runs small observers that compare records and repair mismatches. Its hypothesis connects matter to
protected defects. This illustrated path joins finite examples with the proposed physical interpretation. Each caption separates
computed records from the proof needed to identify position, velocity and mass on one source.
Observers, seams and repairs, and one twist
Clicks that observers compare and agree on.
A controlled particle description with position,
Computed in the model: a result in the stated construction
To derive: a link the program has to prove
Amber: the illustrative defect followed through the chain
The machine compares, repairs and records
The illustrated starting point is a loop of three moves.
An observer here is the smallest kind: a
bookkeeper that holds a few records. Two
neighbors overlap on a seam, where each can
At every tick, neighbors compare. A mismatch
triggers a local repair. A reading that survives
every comparison is kept as a record.
The basic patch wires 12 observers with 30
seams, the corners and edges of an
icosahedron. The physical target is to recover
space, time and matter from the records made
The repair law runs as code. Every outcome is kept as a record, holds and failures
included. One program, state, reference and clock are fixed before anything is
The carrier, the repair law, the scheduler and the detectors are design choices of the
construction. Running them needs no proof that they are the only possible ones.
A twist that no single seam holds
A topological defect is a mismatch that belongs to a whole loop.
Alice, Bob and Charlie each hold a

for the two coins it joins: SAME or

All three rules can be met at once.
Any two rules can be met. All three
One seam is broken in every frame.
Topological defect: a mismatch owned by the loop as a whole. It can sit on any seam of the loop. It cannot sit on none.
A wrinkle in a fitted carpet
Press it flat here and it rises next door. The extra
length belongs to the whole carpet.
Every short piece is an ordinary strip. The half turn
belongs to the whole band, and only a cut
Comb the arrows smooth wherever you like. The
point they circle stays: the full turn is counted on a
The same thing on the real carrier
Each of the 20 triangles is a smallest loop. Multiply the seam
signs around a triangle: +1 is flat, −1 carries a twist. One flipped
seam record (red) twists the two triangles that share it (amber).
Further repair moves the broken seam around and leaves the
A loop whose signs multiply to −1 has no fully settled state. That is a finite theorem. The
twelve-observer patch has 19 independent loops for such signs to sit in.
The plain load records of the carrier have zero loop sums. The twists live in added
transport data: an ordering memory or signs on the seams.
Why nothing local can erase it
The twist is read on a boundary. Whatever happens inside the boundary leaves that reading alone.
An observer may swap its own names for heads
and tails. Both of its seams in the loop flip
together, so the product around the loop stays −1.
Repair moves it and never removes it
Multiply the signs along the edge of a region and
you learn whether it holds a twist. A repair inside
the region never touches the edge. The twist
wanders, and the edge reads −1 as before.
Twists are created in pairs and paid for with work.
When the two meet again they cancel and hand
the work back. Alone, a twist has nothing to cancel
Every outcome K of the repair law commutes with the charge Q: [K, Q] = 0. No order of
repairs switches the sector. Pair creation, transport and annihilation keep the energy
ledger at 2J. Here J is a model energy unit.
Protection covers the stated operations. Resetting the memory that carries the charge,
or reading it in the wrong basis, removes the charge.
A small core, calm surroundings, and one number that every loop around the core reads.
Repair meets it at every tick.
Shrink it or stretch it. While it
encloses the core it reads the
The number the boundary loop reads. It changes only when
something crosses the loop, so it is conserved, and the
Some source channels acquire a minus sign after a full turn.
This is a spinorial symmetry label. Identifying relativistic spin
also requires the field transformation law.
Charge conjugation pairs opposite source charges with equal
energies. Their interpretation as particles and antiparticles
requires the same physical field and interaction records.
A declared texture carries cores of winding +1 and −1. Every allowed repair outcome
preserves both, and the pair supports four localized field modes.
That the bare repair law forms such a core unaided. The map from the protected
memory charge of step 3 to that core, and from its exchange sign to the spin and electric
The pattern is re-established one place over. Different records carry it at every step.
fastest hand-over: one place per tick
Each tick, repair resolves the twist where it sits and finds it again next door.
A wave crosses a lake the same way: the water goes up and down, and the
A relativistic interpretation needs a common limiting speed for all observers.
A finite causal bound alone does not establish this identification with light.
Record-controlled moves carry a twist across the carrier, hop by hop. Influence spreads
inside a cone, and the bound holds uniformly as the lattice is refined.
Free motion of a defect under the repair law alone, with its own momentum and energy
law, and Lorentz symmetry of the limit.
Position is where a record is written
Velocity is the slope of the records
before the record: spread over places
In this quantum preparation the amplitude is spread over places. A position
detector writes a definite record: this detector, this tick, a count of one. The
drawing illustrates the readout, rather than a hidden classical path.
The detector’s law fixes the odds of each click: the squared amplitude. Over
many runs the clicks pile up under the hump. Observers who compare notes
Successive records line up. Places per tick along that line is the velocity.
A Fourier detector reads how phase turns from place to place. Calling that label
conserved momentum requires a translation symmetry of the same field
Place and momentum are two detector settings. A sharp answer to one leaves a
broad spread of answers to the other.
Complete position records and conserved crystal-momentum records of one finite field,
with exact Born weights and a finite uncertainty relation. The selected source has a
complete spatial Fourier readout. A detector coupled to the protected charge has a
different click law in each sector.
The position detector of a moving defect in the selected program. Translation symmetry
of the same Hamiltonian and an energy-dispersion law that attach its Fourier labels to
Mass is the price of standing still
The proposed link: turn a standing repair cost into a measured rest energy.
the core, resolves it, and finds it
an energy gap at zero physical

= c|p| and the wave speed is c. A

range: a top quark has about

The law E² = (pc)² + (mc²)² holds for the declared free field action in its stated limit. The
interacting primary source has a rigorously isolated gauge transition near 63 source
energy units in a rare empty-matter sector.
An excitation that survives with a fixed energy band, its momentum shell, and the rest
mass of a defect computed from its repair cost. No mass in GeV is predicted here.
Observers compress the records into fields
Observers inside hold records. A field is how they summarize what they agree on.
one smooth summary, with error bounds
When a controlled field description predicts the agreed records, its excitations can
be studied as particle candidates. The program must establish that description and
its errors on the same source and state.
The program outputs finite events and records. The continuum belongs to the
description, with a stated domain and error bounds. No extra continuum universe
The selected program has one observable algebra, a stationary limiting state, positive
energy and convergent finite detector histories. Record copies and observer dictionaries
glue into one shared event description.
A nontrivial interacting relativistic field in that limit. Agreement between observers fixes
neither the Born weights nor a relativistic field limit.
The left column is what the program holds. The right column is its proposed physical reading. These are interpretation targets,

Physical targets: spin ½, color charge and
Spin ½, no color. Flavor is unassigned in the
source; neutrino flavor labels are not mass
Higgs mechanism gives W and Z
The Higgs target has spin 0. Its
Under stated premises the twelve-port response carries the algebra u(1) ⊕ su(2) ⊕
su(3), and its fifteen matter states carry the charges of one Standard Model family.
Which defect is which particle. Spin, statistics, three families and the measured masses
on one construction. No row above is an identified OPH defect.
Protected objects have different kinds of labels
These eleven source entries are grouped by what their proofs protect. Only the spatial textures and kinetic nodes carry the stated winding. An
internal charge or protected memory is a different object. The bare source entry is an exclusion control, not a defect.
A coherent orientation bit carries two protected charge sectors under the specified ordered-cover repair.
Required attachment: Attach the bit to a spatially accessible source excitation and a specified energy generator.
A local spin operation creates two opposite conserved internal-charge channels. This charge is not identified with electric charge.
Required attachment: Resolve the created charge channel in operational momentum on its selected state and clock.
Repair preserves the spin information in a fixed-occupation code. Identity repair supplies no winding invariant.
Required attachment: Choose a physical excitation within the code and bind its Hamiltonian, state and clock, including any leakage under evolution.
A specified spin family admits two canonical field pairs with one positive-energy clock. Its physical particle dictionary is unassigned.
Required attachment: Determine the joint energy/momentum spectral measure and stiffness of these actual canonical fields.
A qutrit spin factor survives both the stated field dynamics and repair, with 105 multiplicity states.
Required attachment: Select an operator that changes the energy-carrying multiplicity or number sector, rather than only rotating the protected spin.
A rank-1820 symmetry sector is protected by the specified dynamics and repair. Its label is internal eta symmetry.
Required attachment: Attach the existing local spectroscopy to a moving branch, including complete detector and evolution implementation errors.
Mobile vacancy with a spin record
One missing occupation can be located, while recorded transport carries the remaining spin information.
Required attachment: Bind an energy generator and original joint energy/momentum response to that same recorded transport.
Particle addition, removal and spin probes share an interacting fermion algebra with conserved source occupation.
Required attachment: Prove positive original weight in a fixed energy/momentum branch or charged threshold of this centered family.
A prescribed two-core texture has shell degrees +1 and -1 and four localized band modes. Spontaneous production from repair is not established.
Required attachment: Specify and solve the dynamical creation and motion of the texture itself in the declared source.
Eight kinetic nodes have four positive and four negative windings. A stated scaling family has a conditional free-field map; this does not identify eight observed massless
Required attachment: Prove the physical identification and interaction content of the actual desired family, retaining all opposite-chirality nodes.
Bare source has no nontrivial reducing charge
The full branch commutant is scalar in the specified bare source-only domain. This entry is an exclusion, not a protected defect.
Required attachment: Specify a different declared memory or field extension before proposing a nontrivial protected charge.

species is identified by a label alone.

The picture is a proposed physical interpretation. These linked receipts tell us what the specified finite programs actually establish,
including their source domains and detector failures.
The fifteen internal gauge states match one fermion family’s weights. The
positive charge-six component has charged-lepton-conjugate weights. Three
lepton flavors are not supplied by copying that row. Neutral three-body source
singlets are composite hypotheses, not electron or neutrino identifications.
Protected labels, source excitations and named targets are separate tables.
This exact interacting gauge line uses source energy units. Its certified record
comes from a rare empty-matter sector. A complete loop menu couples to six
scalar, vector and diagonal-tensor cube multiplets. Even scalar and vector
probes cannot create the isolated odd-scalar line from an even-scalar input.
Full-complement bounds control these intervals. Static fusion is not a moving collision.
A four-mode contact echo gives pointer probability 0.0469 to 0.0470; the free
control gives zero within the stated numerical tolerance. Its exact ideal-word
signal is greater than 0.0361998. This is a separate supplied contact action and
preparation. A 32-row moving-packet control is also executed.
Primary-source moving collisions and the separate fine-grid packet run are unexecuted.
THE MASS COMPARISON IS A TEST
The three computed neutral threshold families have any common-scale ratio
below 21.16 at the smallest source member. They cannot be the electron, muon
and tau hierarchy, whose muon/electron ratio is about 206.77. This excludes that
assignment, not other source sectors or capacities.
Required: physical-vacuum channels, a momentum/energy law, controlled capacity errors
and one declared energy unit. Unit conversion alone cannot change mass ratios.

dressed charged channel overlaps the bare-hole channel. A complete detector
records pair-energy transfers in [77/8, 271/8] source units with original probability

svg.text: A catalogue is not a cosmological birth order
The hot early Universe supports a temperature-dependent comparison: quarks and gluons at sufficiently high temperature; photons, electrons,
positrons, neutrinos and nucleons around nucleosynthesis. That does not identify the very first particles or an order of source defects.
Selected source state: ρ = g(H), so [ρ, H] = 0
A fixed one-time source effect has time-independent expectation in this preparation. Conditional apparatus histories can change. A physical early-Universe history
needs an initial preparation, production and cooling dynamics, and a map to observer time. The capacity/refinement index is not that clock; a first click is not a
Every claim about fields and particles runs through one dependency map on one program, state, reference and clock.
